parsed.evidence_quote: The raw data were analyzed using Proteome Discoverer 2.4
HEK 293T cells were seeded
24 µg of BSG-FLAG plasmid was transfected
The protein was then digested by sequencing grade trypsin (1 μg)
followed by addition of iodoacetamide in PBS (final concentration 5 mM)

static modification of carbamidomethylation on cysteine residues (+57.0214 Da), a dynamic oxidation on methionine residues (+15.9949 Da), a dynamic deamidation on asparagine and glutamine residues (+0.9847 Da) and a dynamic modification of the compounds on any amino acid residues (PDAA-13C-CBPA +486.1669)
followed by UV irradiation (365 nm) using a Blak-Ray XX-15L (15 W) lamp for 30 min
followed by anti-FLAG affinity enrichment of FLAG-tagged basigin
The supernatant was loaded onto EZview Red Anti-FLAG M2 Affinity Gel (Sigma, F2426)
